identity: Yes we are.  We still have some of our original collection, but far too much of it was stolen or destroyed, and of course it was far from complete even before.  Some of us go out to try and rebuild the collection from towns nearby, but mostly we rely on people passing through like you.  We especially want anything rare and hard to find.

You have been grabbed and held in place by an attack.  You're not able to move until breaking the grab, and depending on the strength of your opponent using this limb is difficult to impossible.
Wait in place or attempt to move without attacking to try and remove this effect.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of compact bionic module 'Joint Torsion Ratchet CBM'
identity: A set of torsion ratchets that replace the user's joints to slowly generate power when they move.  These can be toggled to generate more power, but movement will require more effort.  This system is actively detrimental to fully mechanical limbs; the additional joint resistance it relies on causes a net loss of bionic power.
